CustomField.description: THE ORG'S text, and null until somebody sets it. SubscriberControlled, so an upgrade never touches it and we cannot overwrite what a customer wrote. Null is not a value: the reader prefers this only where it is populated, so an untouched org silently gets the shipped default and a customised org silently gets its own words, with no flag and no migration.
CustomField.label: Org Override
